audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1].text, and wants.foe[2] all call Xerath's R 'Rite of the Ancients' — the kit's real name is 'Rite of the Arcane'.
audit.why: packet.enemyAbilities.R and enemyKit both give the ultimate's real name as Rite of the Arcane; 'Rite of the Ancients' is a fabricated name of the same kind flagged in the calibration examples (Brand's Ares of Blaze, Cassiopeia's Noxious Blight).
audit.corrected: All three fields corrected to 'Rite of the Arcane (R)'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..3].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..3] already read 'Blitzcrank' — the chart contradicts itself on levels 1 through 4-5.
audit.why: Xerath is completely immobile with a single stun (Shocking Orb, E) and heavy early mana costs per the kit, so a landed Rocket Grab is a near-guaranteed kill early — content's whys[0..3] already say this, the full layer's generic 'Skill' rows never caught up.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side moved to 'Blitzcrank' with why text grounded in his immobility; win[0..3] already correct, left alone per the chart rule.

audit.why: Power spikes correctly flag level 2 (Blitzcrank favor, Xerath immobile), level 6 (Rite of the Arcane lets him punish overextension), and first item (mana/item ramp raises the cost of a whiffed grab) — matches both kits.

edits.before: Even at 6: Rite of the Ancients lets him poke and punish overextension from safety.
edits.after: Even at 6: Rite of the Arcane lets him poke and punish overextension from safety.

edits.before: Shifts to even because Rite of the Ancients (R) lets Xerath fire three long-range global-ish shots that punish you if you overextend for a hook. All-in only when his Shocking Orb (E) is on cooldown: Q, Power Fist (E) the knockup, and burst before he channels his ult from safety.
edits.after: Shifts to even because Rite of the Arcane (R) lets Xerath fire three long-range global-ish shots that punish you if you overextend for a hook. All-in only when his Shocking Orb (E) is on cooldown: Q, Power Fist (E) the knockup, and burst before he channels his ult from safety.

edits.before: Snipe from max range with Rite of the Ancients (R) while staying safe
edits.after: Snipe from max range with Rite of the Arcane (R) while staying safe

edits.before: The hook threat IS level 1 — their duo plays behind minions or pays immediately.
edits.after: Xerath is completely immobile with heavy early mana costs — walking up threatens Rocket Grab and forces him off the wave.

edits.before: E joins: hook-fist is live and the lane's geometry answers to your arm.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: a landed Grab into Power Fist kills before his poke scales, since Xerath has no dash.

edits.before: Full kit: W the flank angles — the hook from fog is the lane's scariest sentence.
edits.after: Bait his Shocking Orb stun then grab on its cooldown — it's down 13s at rank 1 and he has nothing else to stop you.

edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.
edits.after: Hugging the wave denies his Q line-up while your all-in threat still lingers over levels 4-5.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1, down to 11s at rank 5, his only CC — dodge it and the artillery never converts. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Xerath's Arcanopulse (Q) and Eye of Destruction (W) both die to a minion body — hold the wave and his skillshots waste on creeps.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Walking up while Shocking Orb is live trades your Grab for a stun on you — wait for its 13-second cooldown before you commit.

notes: Fabricated ability name: 'Rite of the Ancients' does not exist in Xerath's kit — the real R is Rite of the Arcane (confirmed via packet.enemyAbilities.R and enemyKit).
